text:
Priya: FYI I merged the lockfile regen earlier and now main CI is red :grimacing:
ci-bot: Build 789 failed on linux-x64 pytest runtime/tests/test_kvcache.py::test_multi_session_cache
Priya: Error looks like an HTTP client TLS failure in the test — posting the relevant snippet:
```
E   requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='example.internal', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /health (Caused by SSLError(SSLError("bad handshake: Error([('SSL routines', 'ssl3_get_server_certificate', 'certificate verify failed')])")))
```
Kai: Hmm could be transitive bump in httpcore/urllib3/cryptography from the lock regen. Which dep changed in the lockfile?
Priya: poetry.lock diff shows httpcore 0.17.0 -> 0.18.1 and urllib3 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0, also cryptography moved from 40.0 -> 41.2.1
Morgan: Thanks — rolling dev note: tests that open real TLS connections often break when cryptography/openssl ABI shifts. Does the test use any system-installed certs or requests with verify=False?
Priya: No, it hits our local test server started in the fixture. Everything worked on the previous CI run (before lock regen).
Ash: I kicked a quick rerun with pinned httpcore==0.17.0 on a fork branch to see if it regresses back. CI job: https://ci/internal/789/retry-1
ci-bot: Retry job completed — linux-x64 job now PASSED with httpcore pinned
Kai: OK this strongly implicates httpcore/urllib3 combo. Can someone bisect which package bump is the culprit? I don't want to roll everything back blindly.
Morgan: I'll try a local bisect matrix: iterate httpcore/urllib3/cryptography combinations in a minimal venv and run the failing test. If anyone has a fast reproduce docker image for the test, send it.
Priya: dockerfile for the test: `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/app -w /app python:3.11-bullseye bash -c "pip install -r ci/requirements.txt && pytest runtime/tests/test_kvcache.py::test_multi_session_cache -q"`
Ash: Quick update — I reproduced locally: with (httpcore 0.18.1, urllib3 2.2.0) the test fails consistently. Downgrading urllib3 to 2.1.0 while keeping httpcore 0.18.1 still fails. Downgrading httpcore to 0.17.0 while keeping urllib3 2.2.0 passes. So httpcore is the immediate trigger.
Kai: Nice triangulation. Next steps: open a small PR to pin httpcore back in the lockfile and add a short note in changelog + a follow-up issue to test httpcore upgrade in an isolated env.
Priya: I'll do the PR. Assigning @Morgan for follow-up eval to determine if httpcore change exposed a bug in our TLS test harness or in httpcore.
Morgan: Got it — will start an experiment matrix and report back with a minimal reproducer and a possible patch.
Priya: Cool, thanks all :thumbsup:
